children.text: prathamaḥ sargaḥ
children.translated_text: Canto One

children.text: atha mālyavataḥ prasthe kākutsthasya viyoginaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then, on the slope of Mālyavat, to Kākutstha (Rāma), the one separated [from his beloved],

children.text: durnivārāśrusaṃvego jagāma jaladāgamaḥ //
children.translated_text: the arrival of the clouds came, bringing an irresistible surge of tears.

children.text: atha mālyavataḥ prasthe kākutsthasya viyoginaḥ /
durnivārāśrusaṃvego jagāma jaladāgamaḥ //
śaśāma vṛṣṭir meghānām utsaṅge tasya bhūbhṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: The rain of the clouds ceased upon the lap of that mountain,

children.text: virarāma na rāmasya dhārāsantatir aśruṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: but the continuous stream of Rāma's tears did not cease.

children.text: śaśāma vṛṣṭir meghānām utsaṅge tasya bhūbhṛtaḥ /
virarāma na rāmasya dhārāsantatir aśruṇaḥ //
itas tataḥ pariṇatiṃ bheje barhiṇakūjitam /
children.translated_text: The cries of the peacocks here and there gradually changed their tone,

children.text: hā priye rājaputrīti na rāmaparidevitam //
children.translated_text: but Rāma's lamentation — 'Alas, my beloved, O princess!' — did not.

children.text: itas tataḥ pariṇatiṃ bheje barhiṇakūjitam /
hā priye rājaputri iti na rāmaparidevitam //
kāpy abhikhyā virajasoḥ sūryācandramasor abhūt /
children.translated_text: A certain splendour appeared in the sun and moon, now free of dust,

children.text: dāśarathyos tathaivāsīd ayogopahatā ruciḥ //
children.translated_text: yet the lustre of the two sons of Daśaratha remained impaired, as if by separation.

children.text: ka āpy abhikhyā virajasoḥ sūryācandramasor abhūt /
dāśarathyos tatha aivā asīd ayogopahatā ruciḥ //
nirmalendu nabho reje vikacābjaṃ babhau saraḥ /
children.translated_text: The sky shone with a spotless moon; the lake gleamed with blossoming lotuses;

children.text: paraṃ paryaśruvadanau mamlaturbhrātarāvubhau //
children.translated_text: but both brothers, with tear-streaked faces, grew pale.

children.text: nirmalendu nabho reje vikacābjaṃ babhau saraḥ /
paraṃ paryaśruvadanau mamlaturbhrātarāvubhau //
smartavyakalikājālaṃ jajñe kuṭajakānanam /
children.translated_text: A <s>kuṭaja</s> (wild jasmine) grove appeared, bearing clusters of buds that recalled [her];

children.text: āsīt tathaiva tu mano rāmasyotkalikākulam //
children.translated_text: just so, <s>Rāma</s>'s mind remained agitated with surging longing.

children.text: smartavyakalikājālaṃ jajñe kuṭajakānanam /
āsīt tatha aiva tu mano rāmasya utkalikākulam //
prapede punar udbhedaḥ śucinā kacchaketakaiḥ /
children.translated_text: The fresh sprouting presented itself again with pure <s>kaccha</s> and <s>ketaka</s> flowers,

children.text: upakriyāyāḥ sadṛśaṃ nārebhe ravisūnunā //
children.translated_text: but nothing comparable to a remedy was undertaken by <s>Ravisūnu</s> (<s>Sugrīva</s>, son of the Sun).

children.text: prapede punar udbhedaḥ śucinā kacchaketakaiḥ /
upakriyāyāḥ sadṛśaṃ nā arebhe ravisūnunā //
ākṛṣṭamālatīgandhaḥ siṣeve rāghavaṃ marut /
children.translated_text: The wind, bearing the fragrance of <s>mālatī</s> (jasmine) flowers, attended upon <s>Rāghava</s> (<s>Rāma</s>),

children.text: ānītamaithilīvārtas tam ārtaṃ na tu mārutiḥ //
children.translated_text: but <s>Māruti</s> (<s>Hanumān</s>, son of the Wind), bearing tidings of <s>Maithilī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>), did not attend the afflicted one.

children.text: ākṛṣṭamālatīgandhaḥ siṣeve rāghavaṃ marut /
ānītamaithilīvārtas tam ārtaṃ na tu mārutiḥ //
rāmāya pūrāpagamavyaktoddeśāś cakāśire /
children.translated_text: To <s>Rāma</s>, the rivers shone forth, their directions of overflow now discernible as the floods receded,

children.text: āste 'smāsu na sīteti śaṃsantya iva nimnagāḥ //
children.translated_text: as if proclaiming: '<s>Sītā</s> does not dwell among us.'

children.text: rāmāya pūrāpagamavyaktoddeśāś cakāśire /
āste 'smāsu na sīta īti śaṃsantya iva nimnagāḥ //
yadārdraviraho rāmaḥ prāpitaḥ prāṇasaṃśayam /
children.translated_text: When <s>Rāma</s>, whose separation was still fresh, was brought to the brink of despair,

children.text: nūnaṃ tenānutāpena jagmur jaladarājayaḥ //
children.translated_text: surely it was out of sympathy for his anguish that the hosts of clouds departed.

children.text: yadārdraviraho rāmaḥ prāpitaḥ prāṇasaṃśayam /
nūnaṃ tena anutāpena jagmur jaladarājayaḥ //
dyaur muktameghāvaraṇā savitarkonmukhaṃ muhuḥ /
children.translated_text: The sky, freed from its covering of clouds, repeatedly turned its face toward the sun,

children.text: yayāce sārasarutair vicāram iva rāghavam //
children.translated_text: and with the cries of the <s>sārasa</s> (cranes) seemed to beseech <s>Rāghava</s> for a decision.

children.text: dyaur muktameghāvaraṇā savitarkonmukhaṃ muhuḥ /
yayāce sārasarutair vicāram iva rāghavam //
diśo dadṛśire tena stenaṃ taṃ parimārgatā /
children.translated_text: The directions were seen by him as he searched for that thief [<s>Rāvaṇa</s>],

children.text: mārgadānāparādhinyo gatā dūraṃ bhayād iva //
children.translated_text: as if guilty of not yielding a path and therefore having fled far in fear.

children.text: diśo dadṛśire tena stenaṃ taṃ parimārgatā /
mārgadānāparādhinyo gatā dūraṃ bhayād iva //
tasyākṛtiviśeṣasya viśeṣāt kaṣṭam īdṛśam /
children.translated_text: For one of such singular beauty, that such singular misery should exist —

children.text: kacchāḥ kāśacchalād ūhur itīva palitāgamam //
children.translated_text: the riverbanks, under the pretext of the <s>kāśa</s> grass, seemed to intimate the arrival of grey hair.

children.text: tasyā akṛtiviśeṣasya viśeṣāt kaṣṭam īdṛśam /
kacchāḥ kāśacchalād ūhur iti iva palitāgamam //
paśyantyā iva kaṣṭāṃ tām avasthāṃ maithilīpateḥ /
children.translated_text: As if seeing the pitiable condition of <s>Maithilī</s>'s lord,

children.text: śuṣkapaṅkacayavyājād vidadre hṛdayaṃ bhuvaḥ //
children.translated_text: the heart of the earth cracked open under the pretence of drying mud.

children.text: paśyantyā iva kaṣṭāṃ tām avasthāṃ maithilīpateḥ /
śuṣkapaṅkacayavyājād vidadre hṛdayaṃ bhuvaḥ //
vṛṣṭivicchedajātena tānavenāsamāptinā /
children.translated_text: Through the unfinished thinning born of the cessation of rain,

children.text: prapedire jaladharās tasya sabrahmacāritām //
children.translated_text: the clouds attained the state of fellow-celibates with him.

children.text: vṛṣṭivicchedajātena tānavena asamāptinā /
prapedire jaladharās tasya sabrahmacāritām //
yayau virahasaṃvartaḥ padminīrājahaṃsayoḥ /
children.translated_text: The separation of the lotus and the royal swan passed away [with the season],

children.text: apāraduḥkhārṇavayor na sītārāmabhadrayoḥ //
children.translated_text: but not that of <s>Sītā</s> and <s>Rāmabhadra</s>, those two [plunged in] a boundless ocean of suffering.

children.text: yayau virahasaṃvartaḥ padminīrājahaṃsayoḥ /
apāraduḥkhārṇavayor na sītārāmabhadrayoḥ //
śāntanirjharajhātkāradhārāḥ śikhariṇo babhuḥ /
children.translated_text: The mountain peaks stood with their waterfall sounds and flowing streams quieted,

children.text: rāmasya viśadālāpaśuśrūṣānibhṛtā iva //
children.translated_text: as if hushed in eager attention for <s>Rāma</s>'s clear-voiced speech.

children.text: śāntanirjharajhātkāradhārāḥ śikhariṇo babhuḥ /
rāmasya viśadālāpaśuśrūṣānibhṛtā iva //
tasya cakruś camatkāraṃ vyatītasamayā api /
children.translated_text: The ranks of <s>kadamba</s> groves, though their season had passed,

children.text: smitābhamukulodbhedāḥ kadambavanarājayaḥ //
children.translated_text: caused him wonder, with buds bursting forth like the gleam of a smile.

children.text: tasya cakruś camatkāraṃ vyatītasamayā api /
smitābhamukulodbhedāḥ kadambavanarājayaḥ //
adṛśyanta puras tena khelāḥ khañjanapaṅktayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Rows of wagtails were seen before him, playing,

children.text: asmaryanta ca niśvasya priyānayanavibhramāḥ //
children.translated_text: and with a sigh, the playful movements of his beloved's eyes were recalled.

children.text: adṛśyanta puras tena khelāḥ khañjanapaṅktayaḥ /
asmaryanta ca niśvasya priyānayanavibhramāḥ //
abravīd atha kālajñas tatkālapratipattaye /
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, who knew the right time, bowing before <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: praṇamya lakṣmaṇo rāmaṃ rāmāvirahaniḥsaham //
children.translated_text: who was unable to bear separation from his wife, spoke for the purpose of rousing him to timely action:

children.text: abravīd atha kālajñas tatkālapratipattaye /
praṇamya lakṣmaṇo rāmaṃ rāmāvirahaniḥsaham //
jātaṃ vibhātam amalaṃ paśya prāvṛṇṇiśā gatā /
children.translated_text: 'Look, dawn has broken, pure — the rainy night has passed;

children.text: utsāhakamalasyāyaṃ vikāsāvasaras tava //
children.translated_text: this is the moment for the blossoming of the lotus of your resolve.

children.text: jātaṃ vibhātam amalaṃ paśya prāvṛṇṇiśā gatā /
utsāhakamalasya ayaṃ vikāsāvasaras tava //
ucchrayaṃ tīrataravo raver ūrjam abhīṣavaḥ /
children.translated_text: The trees on the banks gain height; the sun's rays gain vigour;

children.text: madaṃ gopatayo gṛhṇanty abhiyogaṃ jigīṣavaḥ //
children.translated_text: the bulls gain their passion; those who wish to conquer take up their enterprise.

children.text: ucchrayaṃ tīrataravo raver ūrjam abhīṣavaḥ /
madaṃ gopatayo gṛhṇanty abhiyogaṃ jigīṣavaḥ //
prasīda dīyatāṃ karṇaḥ kūjadbhiḥ kurarair amī /
children.translated_text: Be pleased — let your ear be given to these crying curlews;

children.text: prārthayantīva saṃcāraṃ taṭāḥ kardamadurgatāḥ //
children.translated_text: these riverbanks, rendered impassable by mud, seem to beg for your passage.

children.text: prasīda dīyatāṃ karṇaḥ kūjadbhiḥ kurarair amī /
prārthayanti iva saṃcāraṃ taṭāḥ kardamadurgatāḥ //
bhuvi bhāsvadabhīṣūṇāṃ tvadiṣūṇāṃ ca śatruṣu /
children.translated_text: Of the bright one's (<s>Sūrya</s>'s) arrows upon the earth, and of your arrows upon enemies,

children.text: ayaṃ sampatituṃ kālaḥ sa duṣkālo 'tivāhitaḥ //
children.translated_text: this is the time to strike — that adverse season has passed.

children.text: bhuvi bhāsvadabhīṣūṇāṃ tvadiṣūṇāṃ ca śatruṣu /
ayaṃ sampatituṃ kālaḥ sa duṣkālo 'tivāhitaḥ //
sudūronnataparyantās tīryante saṃkramair iva /
children.translated_text: The rivers, very deep, with banks exceedingly high and distant,

children.text: analpagādhāḥ saritas tarubhiḥ pūrapātitaiḥ //
children.translated_text: are being crossed as if by bridges, by the trees uprooted and felled by floods.

children.text: sudūronnataparyantās tīryante saṃkramair iva /
analpagādhāḥ saritas tarubhiḥ pūrapātitaiḥ //
āviṣkṛtaviśuddhibhyāṃ nadyaḥ sumahilā iva /
children.translated_text: The rivers, with their purity now revealed,

children.text: kulābhyām iva kūlābhyām āpatsv api cakāsati //
children.translated_text: shine like noble women through their lineage, even in calamity, through their banks.

children.text: āviṣkṛtaviśuddhibhyāṃ nadyaḥ sumahilā iva /
kulābhyām iva kūlābhyām āpatsv api cakāsati //
jalajānāṃ sumanasāṃ vayasāṃ jalasevinām /
children.translated_text: Of aquatic flowers, of birds frequenting the waters,

children.text: asya pratijalādhāraṃ sāmagryam avalokyate //
children.translated_text: and of this [season], the auspicious assembly at every body of water is seen.

children.text: jalajānāṃ sumanasāṃ vayasāṃ jalasevinām /
asya pratijalādhāraṃ sāmagryam avalokyate //
yuyutsārabhasotkhātasaritkhātakarodhasaḥ /
children.translated_text: The hump-backed bulls, whose muddy banks have been dug up in the frenzy of their eagerness to fight,

children.text: kukudmanto madakalāḥ kalayanti jaganty adhaḥ //
children.translated_text: survey the world below, bellowing with passionate roars.

children.text: yuyutsārabhasotkhātasaritkhātakarodhasaḥ /
kukudmanto madakalāḥ kalayanti jaganty adhaḥ //
viśveśa kuru viśvāsam āvartante na te ghanāḥ /
children.translated_text: O Lord of the Universe, take heart — your clouds will not return;

children.text: amī śyāmalayanty āśāḥ śukāḥ śālivanonmukhāḥ //
children.translated_text: see, these parrots, eager for the rice fields, are darkening the horizons.

children.text: viśveśa kuru viśvāsam āvartante na te ghanāḥ /
amī śyāmalayanty āśāḥ śukāḥ śālivanonmukhāḥ //
mṛgāḥ samprati śāleyaṃ sampannaṃ sampatanty amī /
children.translated_text: These deer are now rushing upon the ripened rice crop,

children.text: sāketam adhitiṣṭhantam arthinas tvām ivonmukhāḥ //
children.translated_text: gazing upward, like supplicants approaching you who preside over <s>Sāketa</s> (<s>Ayodhyā</s>).

children.text: mṛgāḥ samprati śāleyaṃ sampannaṃ sampatanty amī /
sāketam adhitiṣṭhantam arthinas tvām iva unmukhāḥ //
kāryadig gṛhyatāṃ kāpi kim ārya sthīyate vṛthā /
children.translated_text: Let some direction of action be taken — why, O noble one, do you sit idle?

children.text: evam evāyam asmākam iṣṭo 'pi kim upaiṣyati //
children.translated_text: Will this [grief] of ours, however cherished, really pass away just like this?

children.text: kāryadig gṛhyatāṃ ka āpi kim ārya sthīyate vṛthā /
evam eva ayam asmākam iṣṭo 'pi kim upaiṣyati //
vijayāya bhavāsīno mayy arpitavapurbharaḥ /
children.translated_text: You who sit for the purpose of victory, having placed the burden of your body upon me —

children.text: mūrcchānuvalanavyastaḥ prastaras tyajyatām ayam //
children.translated_text: let this stone slab, made useless by the tossing of your fainting spells, be abandoned.

children.text: vijayāya bhavāsīno mayy arpitavapurbharaḥ /
mūrcchānuvalanavyastaḥ prastaras tyajyatām ayam //
pratīṣṭopatyakāsāladalāgrajalabindavaḥ /
children.translated_text: Your matted locks, with water-drops at the tips of their leaf-like strands from the mountain-slopes being kissed by rain,

children.text: sāryantāṃ kṣaṇam uddhūya sthagitāṃsataṭā jaṭāḥ //
children.translated_text: let them be shaken out for a moment, their shoulder-covering tangles cast aside.

children.text: pratīṣṭopatyakāsāladalāgrajalabindavaḥ /
sāryantāṃ kṣaṇam uddhūya sthagitāṃsataṭā jaṭāḥ //
muhūrtaṃ kriyatām ārya kapolavirahī karaḥ /
children.translated_text: O noble one, let your hand part from your cheek for a moment;

children.text: vyuṣito valkalagranthir aṃsād unmocyatām ayam //
children.translated_text: this bark-garment knot that has come undone — let it be retied at the shoulder.

children.text: muhūrtaṃ kriyatām ārya kapolavirahī karaḥ /
vyuṣito valkalagranthir aṃsād unmocyatām ayam //
ito vitatya dīyantām iṣavaḥ klinnayantraṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: Let the arrows, their bindings dampened, be spread out from here to dry;

children.text: nirmuktārdrajaraccailam ādattām āyataṃ dhanuḥ //
children.translated_text: let the long bow be taken up, its wet old covering removed.

children.text: ito vitatya dīyantām iṣavaḥ klinnayantraṇāḥ /
nirmuktārdrajaraccailam ādattām āyataṃ dhanuḥ //
ito 'vatīryatāṃ prāsthād asvāsthyam idam ujjhyatām /
children.translated_text: Come down from this mountain slope; let this ill-ease be cast off;

children.text: jahīṣubhir daśagrīvaṃ daśadigvedhaśodhitaiḥ //
children.translated_text: slay <s>Daśagrīva</s> (<s>Rāvaṇa</s>, the ten-headed) with arrows tested in piercing all ten directions.

children.text: ito 'vatīryatāṃ prāsthād asvāsthyam idam ujjhyatām /
jahi iṣubhir daśagrīvaṃ daśadigvedhaśodhitaiḥ //
ṛjur ādīyatāṃ panthāḥ kāryakanthā garīyasī /
children.translated_text: Let the straight path be taken — the burden of duty is weighty;

children.text: utsāryatām idaṃ dūraṃ tamaḥ kiṃkāryatāmayam //
children.translated_text: let this darkness of indecision be driven far away.

children.text: ṛjur ādīyatāṃ panthāḥ kāryakanthā garīyasī /
utsāryatām idaṃ dūraṃ tamaḥ kiṃkāryatāmayam //
āryāyāḥ śivam evāsti śatrur nihata eva te /
children.translated_text: All is well with the noble lady (<s>Sītā</s>); your enemy is as good as slain;

children.text: alaṃ dattvāvasādāya trailokyaśaraṇaṃ vapuḥ //
children.translated_text: do not give over to despondency that body which is the refuge of the three worlds.

children.text: āryāyāḥ śivam eva asti śatrur nihata eva te /
alaṃ dattva āvasādāya trailokyaśaraṇaṃ vapuḥ //
rākṣasāpaśadaḥ ko 'sau tvayi sajyaśarāsane /
children.translated_text: What is that <s>Rākṣasa</s> (demon) wretch, when you have bow strung with arrow?

children.text: anena te 'vasādena dūram āropitaḥ punaḥ //
children.translated_text: By this despondency of yours, he has been elevated far indeed, once again.

children.text: rākṣasāpaśadaḥ ko 'sau tvayi sajyaśarāsane /
anena te 'vasādena dūram āropitaḥ punaḥ //
aśruvegaiḥ pramīlābhir vilāpair akhilaḥ sa te /
children.translated_text: With torrents of tears, with drooping eyelids, with laments — your entire

children.text: āmṛṣṭadehayātrasya māsaḥ prauṣṭhapado gataḥ //
children.translated_text: month of <s>Prauṣṭhapada</s> (Bhādrapada) has passed, with bodily sustenance barely maintained.

children.text: aśruvegaiḥ pramīlābhir vilāpair akhilaḥ sa te /
āmṛṣṭadehayātrasya māsaḥ prauṣṭhapado gataḥ //
kriyatām adhunotsāhaś cintyatāṃ nidhanaṃ dviṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: Let resolve be mustered now; let the destruction of the enemy be contemplated;

children.text: kaḥ svabāhusahāyānāṃ mahatām ātmanigrahaḥ //
children.translated_text: what self-restraint is this for great men whose own arms are their allies?

children.text: kriyatām adhuna ūtsāhaś cintyatāṃ nidhanaṃ dviṣaḥ /
kaḥ svabāhusahāyānāṃ mahatām ātmanigrahaḥ //
bhadraṃ bhādrapadacchedacchinnābhrājinarajjave /
children.translated_text: Blessings upon you, O best among men, whose rope-garment of cloudy bark is now cut away by the clearing of <s>Bhādrapada</s> —

children.text: tubhyaṃ puruṣanāgāya nirvighnatarase 'dhunā //
children.translated_text: may you now rush forward unobstructed!

children.text: bhadraṃ bhādrapadacchedacchinnābhrājinarajjave /
tubhyaṃ puruṣanāgāya nirvighnatarase 'dhunā //
prasīda kuru bhūyo 'pi dehayātrāṃ yathā tathā /
children.translated_text: Be pleased; carry on your bodily existence somehow or other;

children.text: anullaṅghitavijñaptir lakṣmaṇo 'varajeṣu te //
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, whose requests are never transgressed, is the youngest among your brothers.

children.text: prasīda kuru bhūyo 'pi dehayātrāṃ yathā tathā /
anullaṅghitavijñaptir lakṣmaṇo 'varajeṣu te //
agādhaṃ dhairyam āryasya triṣu lokeṣu gīyate /
children.translated_text: The unfathomable fortitude of the noble one is celebrated in the three worlds;

children.text: janamātrocitaḥ ko 'yam ākalpakaparigrahaḥ //
children.translated_text: what is this seizure of grief, fit only for common folk?

children.text: agādhaṃ dhairyam āryasya triṣu lokeṣu gīyate /
janamātrocitaḥ ko 'yam ākalpakaparigrahaḥ //
aropaśamitodagrajāmadagnyāgnitejasaḥ /
children.translated_text: Who can withstand the shower of your arrows, O noble one,

children.text: pratīcchati śarāsāraṃ tavārya ruṣitasya kaḥ //
children.translated_text: when you are angered — you, who quelled the towering fire-energy of <s>Jāmadagnya</s> (<s>Paraśurāma</s>) with your bow?

children.text: aropaśamitodagrajāmadagnyāgnitejasaḥ /
pratīcchati śarāsāraṃ tavā arya ruṣitasya kaḥ //
svakṛtyabhārasannyāsī yāvad itthaṃ viṣīdasi /
children.translated_text: As long as you sit despondent thus, laying down the burden of your own duty,

children.text: tāvad antakadaṃṣṭrāṇām arātir atithir na te //
children.translated_text: for that long your enemy is not a guest of <s>Antaka</s>'s (Death's) fangs.

children.text: svakṛtyabhārasannyāsī yāvad itthaṃ viṣīdasi /
tāvad antakadaṃṣṭrāṇām arātir atithir na te //
ātatāyī sa vijñāto jīvaty āryeti ca śrutam /
children.translated_text: That aggressor has been identified; it is heard that the noble lady lives;

children.text: prāpto yātrāsahaḥ kālaḥ kālakṣepasya ko guṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: the season fit for military march has arrived — what virtue is there in further delay?

children.text: ātatāyī sa vijñāto jīvaty ārya īti ca śrutam /
prāpto yātrāsahaḥ kālaḥ kālakṣepasya ko guṇaḥ //
na jñāyate paraṃ vyaktam arer māyāvinaḥ padam /
children.translated_text: The abode of the enemy, the illusionist, is truly not clearly known,

children.text: tanmārgaṇaṃ ca suhṛdā sugrīveṇa pratiśrutam //
children.translated_text: but the search for it has been promised by our ally <s>Sugrīva</s>.

children.text: na jñāyate paraṃ vyaktam arer māyāvinaḥ padam /
tanmārgaṇaṃ ca suhṛdā sugrīveṇa pratiśrutam //
diṅmukhāhūtavikhyātakapiyūthaḥ kapīśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: The lord of the monkeys, having summoned the renowned monkey armies from all directions,

children.text: kṣaṇān nūnam asav āryapādamūle patiṣyati //
children.translated_text: will surely in a moment fall at the noble one's feet.

children.text: diṅmukhāhūtavikhyātakapiyūthaḥ kapīśvaraḥ /
kṣaṇān nūnam asav āryapādamūle patiṣyati //
śālipiṅgamahīpṛṣṭhaspardhayeva bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: The sky will become tawny with the massed descent of swift monkeys,

children.text: raṃhasviharisaṃghātasampātakapilaṃ nabhaḥ //
children.translated_text: as if competing with the earth's surface golden with ripened rice.

children.text: śālipiṅgamahīpṛṣṭhaspardhaya īva bhaviṣyati /
raṃhasviharisaṃghātasampātakapilaṃ nabhaḥ //
teṣām āroṣarucirair acirān mukhamaṇḍalaiḥ /
children.translated_text: Soon, with their faces radiant with eager zeal,

children.text: drakṣyate taruṇādityaśatacchannam ivāmbaram //
children.translated_text: the sky will appear as if covered with a hundred young suns.

children.text: teṣām āroṣarucirair acirān mukhamaṇḍalaiḥ /
drakṣyate taruṇādityaśatacchannam iva ambaram //
aho dīptir aho kāntir aho śīlam aho balam /
children.translated_text: Ah, what brilliance! Ah, what grace! Ah, what character! Ah, what strength!

children.text: aho śaktir aho bhaktir aho prajñā hanūmataḥ //
children.translated_text: Ah, what power! Ah, what devotion! Ah, what wisdom <s>Hanumān</s> possesses!

children.text: aho dīptir aho kāntir aho śīlam aho balam /
aho śaktir aho bhaktir aho prajñā hanūmataḥ //
pragalbhenāpramattena tenābhyantaramantriṇā /
children.translated_text: Surely, by that bold, vigilant, and trusted inner counsellor,

children.text: nūnam asmatkṛte svaptuṃ sugrīvāya na dīyate //
children.translated_text: <s>Sugrīva</s> is not being allowed to sleep on our account.

children.text: pragalbhena apramattena tena abhyantaramantriṇā /
nūnam asmatkṛte svaptuṃ sugrīvāya na dīyate //
sa ca pratyupakārāya tvarayaty enam ādṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: And with respectful haste, he is urging him [<s>Sugrīva</s>] to reciprocate the favour,

children.text: dhruvaṃ buddhivayovṛddhaḥ sacivo jāmbavān api //
children.translated_text: as is surely <s>Jāmbavān</s>, the minister, who is senior in both wisdom and age.

children.text: sa ca pratyupakārāya tvarayaty enam ādṛtaḥ /
dhruvaṃ buddhivayovṛddhaḥ sacivo jāmbavān api //
tad evaṃ hetunā kena vānarendro vilambate /
children.translated_text: Therefore, for what reason does the lord of the monkeys delay?

children.text: nāsau kṛtaghnasya bhaved guṇavadbhṛtyasaṃgrahaḥ //
children.translated_text: An ungrateful person cannot retain the service of virtuous attendants.

children.text: tad evaṃ hetunā kena vānarendro vilambate /
na asau kṛtaghnasya bhaved guṇavadbhṛtyasaṃgrahaḥ //
āgantavyaṃ dhruvaṃ tena mārgitāryā pravṛttinā /
children.translated_text: He must surely come, with the effort of having searched for the noble lady under way,

children.text: prapannaparakṛtyānām atyuṣṇo hi samudyamaḥ //
children.translated_text: for the exertion of those who have devoted themselves to another's cause is exceedingly fervent.

children.text: āgantavyaṃ dhruvaṃ tena mārgitā āryā pravṛttinā /
prapannaparakṛtyānām atyuṣṇo hi samudyamaḥ //
tvatprasādāptasambhogasukhasaṃmīlitena vā /
children.translated_text: Or perhaps, with eyes closed in the enjoyment of pleasures obtained by your grace,

children.text: na tenāmūr dadṛśire diśaḥ proṣitakālikāḥ //
children.translated_text: he has not noticed these directions, fit now for the season of departure.

children.text: tvatprasādāptasambhogasukhasaṃmīlitena vā /
na tena amūr dadṛśire diśaḥ proṣitakālikāḥ //
kiyacciraṃ punar asau tasya na śrutim eṣyati /
children.translated_text: How much longer, moreover, will the cry of the swans on his pleasure-lake

children.text: krīḍātaṭākahaṃsānāṃ ninādo madamūrchitaḥ //
children.translated_text: not reach his hearing — that sound, swelling with intoxication?

children.text: kiyacciraṃ punar asau tasya na śrutim eṣyati /
krīḍātaṭākahaṃsānāṃ ninādo madamūrchitaḥ //
uktaiḥ kim atha bhūyobhir adya śvo vāgamiṣyati /
children.translated_text: But what use are further words? Today or tomorrow

children.text: paryutsukitakiṣkindhaḥ satyasandho harīśvaraḥ //
children.translated_text: the lord of the monkeys, true to his word, will come, with <s>Kiṣkindhā</s> all astir.

children.text: uktaiḥ kim atha bhūyobhir adya śvo vā āgamiṣyati /
paryutsukitakiṣkindhaḥ satyasandho harīśvaraḥ //
vyatireke 'pi yat kāryaṃ tadapyārya pradhāryatām /
children.translated_text: But even in the event of his failure, let the noble one consider what must be done;

children.text: gṛhyatāṃ kāryasiddhir nas tadvilambatiraskṛtā //
children.translated_text: let the accomplishment of our purpose be seized, not obscured by his delay.

children.text: vyatireke 'pi yat kāryaṃ tadapyārya pradhāryatām /
gṛhyatāṃ kāryasiddhir nas tadvilambatiraskṛtā //
yas tathopakṛtaḥ pūrvam āryeṇāryākṛte 'dhunā /
children.translated_text: He who was so greatly aided before by the noble one — for the noble lady's sake, now,

children.text: sa śītalaḥ syād athavā paracittāni vetti kaḥ //
children.translated_text: he may perhaps turn cold; or, who can know the minds of others?

children.text: yas tatha ūpakṛtaḥ pūrvam āryeṇā aryākṛte 'dhunā /
sa śītalaḥ syād athavā paracittāni vetti kaḥ //
sa pratiśrutam arthaṃ naḥ sphīto vismṛtavān iva /
children.translated_text: He, having grown prosperous, appears to have forgotten the purpose he promised us;

children.text: gatvāśu smāryatām ārya kāryataptasya kā kṣamā //
children.translated_text: go swiftly, O noble one, and remind him — for one burning with duty, what patience is there?

children.text: sa pratiśrutam arthaṃ naḥ sphīto vismṛtavān iva /
gatvā āśu smāryatām ārya kāryataptasya kā kṣamā //
tam ahaṃ bodhayiṣyāmi daṇḍagarbhābhir uktibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: I shall rouse him with words pregnant with threat;

children.text: sāma saṃmīlayaty eva sukhasaktān pramādinaḥ //
children.translated_text: conciliation only lulls the pleasure-addicted and the negligent to deeper sleep.

children.text: tam ahaṃ bodhayiṣyāmi daṇḍagarbhābhir uktibhiḥ /
sāma saṃmīlayaty eva sukhasaktān pramādinaḥ //
prasīda jīyatāṃ mohaḥ ko 'ham ity avadhīyatām /
children.translated_text: Be pleased; let delusion be conquered; let it be considered: who am I?

children.text: drutam uttīrṇa evāste vyasanābdhiḥ kiyān ayam //
children.translated_text: Quickly — this ocean of adversity is already all but crossed — how great can it be?'

children.text: prasīda jīyatāṃ mohaḥ ko 'ham ity avadhīyatām /
drutam uttīrṇa evā aste vyasanābdhiḥ kiyān ayam //
sūnṛtair iti saumitreḥ prītaḥ pīyūṣavarṣibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus pleased by <s>Saumitri</s>'s (<s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>'s) words, which rained nectar of truthful kindness,

children.text: tam antarvedanāvegaṃ jigāyeva raghūdvahaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Raghu</s>'s descendant (<s>Rāma</s>) seemed almost to conquer that surge of inner anguish.

children.text: sūnṛtair iti saumitreḥ prītaḥ pīyūṣavarṣibhiḥ /
tam antarvedanāvegaṃ jigāya iva raghūdvahaḥ //
unmīlayāmāsa dṛśau diśaḥ kiṃcid alokata /
children.translated_text: He opened his eyes, looked somewhat toward the directions,

children.text: unnanāma ca talpāntān mocayan pakṣmalā jaṭāḥ //
children.translated_text: and raised himself from the edge of the couch, freeing his fringed matted locks.

children.text: unmīlayāmāsa dṛśau diśaḥ kiṃcid alokata /
unnanāma ca talpāntān mocayan pakṣmalā jaṭāḥ //
satvaraprahvasaumitricīrotsāritareṇuni /
children.translated_text: On a clean stone surface nearby, the dust cleared away

children.text: śucini kvacid āsanne niṣasāda śilātale //
children.translated_text: by <s>Saumitri</s> (<s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>) who had hastily and humbly [swept it] with the hem of his bark garment, he sat down.

children.text: satvaraprahvasaumitricīrotsāritareṇuni /
śucini kvacid āsanne niṣasāda śilātale //
upaviṣṭas tadā rāmo na reje sītayā vinā /
children.translated_text: Seated thus, <s>Rāma</s> did not shine without <s>Sītā</s>,

children.text: dhvajo nirvaijayantīkaḥ paurandara ivocchritaḥ //
children.translated_text: like the banner of <s>Purandara</s> (<s>Indra</s>), raised aloft but without the victory-pennant.

children.text: upaviṣṭas tadā rāmo na reje sītayā vinā /
dhvajo nirvaijayantīkaḥ paurandara iva ucchritaḥ //
anūpaviṣṭam anujaṃ danujārim ivādrijit /
children.translated_text: To his younger brother who had seated himself beside him, like <s>Indra</s> the mountain-conqueror [addressing his companion],

children.text: pratyabhāṣata vātsalyagadgadāni padāni saḥ //
children.translated_text: he spoke these words, faltering with affection:

children.text: anūpaviṣṭam anujaṃ danujārim iva adrijit /
pratyabhāṣata vātsalyagadgadāni padāni saḥ //
ehy ehi priyasaṃlāpa hlādayāliṅgitena mām /
children.translated_text: Come, come, O you whose conversation is dear — embrace me and console me;

children.text: ruddhaṃ ruddham upaity aśru tvām apīkṣe na lakṣmaṇa //
children.translated_text: tears surge up again and again — I cannot even look upon you, O <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>.

children.text: ehy ehi priyasaṃlāpa hlādayā āliṅgitena mām /
ruddhaṃ ruddham upaity aśru tvām apī ikṣe na lakṣmaṇa //
hā vatsa bhavato 'pīyam avasthāṅgeṣu vartate /
children.translated_text: Alas, my child, this condition afflicts your limbs too;

children.text: dhriyatāṃ rāmahatakaḥ kleśayann ekabāndhavam //
children.translated_text: may the wretch <s>Rāma</s> be endured, who brings suffering to his sole kinsman.

children.text: hā vatsa bhavato 'pi iyam avastha āṅgeṣu vartate /
dhriyatāṃ rāmahatakaḥ kleśayann ekabāndhavam //
nāsti vatsa cikitsāsya vyādher vidhurajanmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: There is no cure, my child, for this disease born of wretched fate,

children.text: yasya yāpanayā kṣīṇam idaṃ te sāntvanāmṛtam //
children.translated_text: in whose mere palliation this nectar of your consolation has been spent.

children.text: na asti vatsa cikitsa āsya vyādher vidhurajanmanaḥ /
yasya yāpanayā kṣīṇam idaṃ te sāntvanāmṛtam //
naikadurvāraghorādhighaṭṭanācalitā api /
children.translated_text: Even though shaken by the many unbearable and terrible blows of adversity,

children.text: tavāśvāsanayā vatsa na gacchanti mamāsavaḥ //
children.translated_text: my life-breaths do not depart, my child, because of your comforting.

children.text: naikadurvāraghorādhighaṭṭanācalitā api /
tavā aśvāsanayā vatsa na gacchanti mama asavaḥ //
pitur naḥ priyamitrasya lūnapakṣasya maddviṣā /
children.translated_text: Recalling the mortal wound of <s>Jaṭāyus</s>, the dear friend of our father,

children.text: saṃsmaran notsahe vatsa marmacchedaṃ jaṭāyuṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: whose wings were clipped by my enemy, I cannot bear it, my child.

children.text: pitur naḥ priyamitrasya lūnapakṣasya maddviṣā /
saṃsmaran na utsahe vatsa marmacchedaṃ jaṭāyuṣaḥ //
tātasya tātamitrasya vatsavatsalayos tayoḥ /
children.translated_text: Of father's friend, of that pair so tenderly affectionate to a child,

children.text: aham eva gataḥ pāpo nidhanāya nimittatām //
children.translated_text: it is I, the sinful one, who have become the cause of their destruction.

children.text: tātasya tātamitrasya vatsavatsalayos tayoḥ /
aham eva gataḥ pāpo nidhanāya nimittatām //
priyāpahārajaḥ śāmyet samyag unmūlite ripau /
children.translated_text: The anger born of the abduction of my beloved might be quelled by the thorough uprooting of the enemy;

children.text: manyur dehāvadhir ayaṃ tātamitravipattibhūḥ //
children.translated_text: but this [anguish], born of the calamity to my father's friend, will last as long as this body.

children.text: priyāpahārajaḥ śāmyet samyag unmūlite ripau /
manyur dehāvadhir ayaṃ tātamitravipattibhūḥ //
nabhastalāt khagapatau patati cchinnapakṣatau /
children.translated_text: When the king of birds was falling from the sky, his wings severed,

children.text: ko 'paras tāṃ mama suhṛn mā bhaiṣīr ity abhāṣata //
children.translated_text: what other friend of mine said to me: 'Do not fear!'?

children.text: nabhastalāt khagapatau patati cchinnapakṣatau /
ko 'paras tāṃ mama suhṛn mā bhaiṣīr ity abhāṣata //
syād vatsa rāmahatakāt klībaḥ kaḥ puruṣo 'paraḥ /
children.translated_text: O child, what other man could be more impotent than the wretch <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: ekapatnīm anugatām arāter yo na rakṣati //
children.translated_text: who does not protect his faithful wife, who followed him alone, from his enemy?

children.text: syād vatsa rāmahatakāt klībaḥ kaḥ puruṣo 'paraḥ /
ekapatnīm anugatām arāter yo na rakṣati //
tayā teṣu tapasvinyā sīdator āvayor api /
children.translated_text: By that ascetic woman, even while both of us were suffering,

children.text: daṇḍakāraṇyakaṣṭeṣu mukhaṃ na vidhurīkṛtam //
children.translated_text: amid the hardships of the <s>Daṇḍaka</s> forest, her face was never made to look distressed.

children.text: tayā teṣu tapasvinyā sīdator āvayor api /
daṇḍakāraṇyakaṣṭeṣu mukhaṃ na vidhurīkṛtam //
videharājasya sutā snuṣā daśarathasya sā /
children.translated_text: She, the daughter of the king of <s>Videha</s>, the daughter-in-law of <s>Daśaratha</s> —

children.text: hatarāmasya jāyeti bhramati sma vane vane //
children.translated_text: with the cry 'the wife of the slain <s>Rāma</s>!' — she wanders from forest to forest.

children.text: videharājasya sutā snuṣā daśarathasya sā /
hatarāmasya jāya īti bhramati sma vane vane //
svam apy apuṣṇatā kāyam api jāyām arakṣatā /
children.translated_text: By me who did not even nourish my own body, who failed to protect even his wife —

children.text: mayā samaḥ śrutaḥ ko 'pi jātaḥ klībo raghoḥ kule //
children.translated_text: has anyone been heard of, born in the lineage of <s>Raghu</s>, as impotent as I?

children.text: svam apy apuṣṇatā kāyam api jāyām arakṣatā /
mayā samaḥ śrutaḥ ko 'pi jātaḥ klībo raghoḥ kule //
tvaṃ kevalaṃ na subhrātā tathā vilapatā muhuḥ /
children.translated_text: You alone are not a good brother — so often lamenting thus,

children.text: tiryañco 'pi mayāmuṣmin vane lakṣmaṇa roditāḥ //
children.translated_text: even the animals, O <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, have been made to weep by me in that forest.

children.text: tvaṃ kevalaṃ na subhrātā tathā vilapatā muhuḥ /
tiryañco 'pi maya āmuṣmin vane lakṣmaṇa roditāḥ //
dikṣu sannaddhameghāsu mama ghorādhisākṣiṇām /
children.translated_text: When the directions were armoured with clouds, as witnesses to my terrible affliction,

children.text: avahan nirjharanibhān nagānām aśrunimnagāḥ //
children.translated_text: the mountains shed rivers of tears like waterfalls.

children.text: dikṣu sannaddhameghāsu mama ghorādhisākṣiṇām /
avahan nirjharanibhān nagānām aśrunimnagāḥ //
ārād ākarṇitasnigdhanavābdaninadair api /
children.translated_text: Even the peacocks, though they heard from afar the sweet rumbling of fresh clouds,

children.text: matkāruṇyād araṇye 'pi nānṛtyata kalāpibhiḥ //
children.translated_text: out of compassion for me, did not dance even in the forest.

children.text: ārād ākarṇitasnigdhanavābdaninadair api /
matkāruṇyād araṇye 'pi na anṛtyata kalāpibhiḥ //
satyam eṣyati sugrīvaḥ satyaṃ jīvati jānakī /
children.translated_text: Truly <s>Sugrīva</s> will come; truly <s>Jānakī</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) lives;

children.text: tvadvaco na viparyeti bhrātar brūhi punaḥ punaḥ //
children.translated_text: your words cannot prove false — O brother, say it again and again.

children.text: satyam eṣyati sugrīvaḥ satyaṃ jīvati jānakī /
tvadvaco na viparyeti bhrātar brūhi punaḥ punaḥ //
tvadvākyaśīkarair ebhir niruddhabahirudgamaḥ /
children.translated_text: By these spray-like words of yours, the outward surging having been checked,

children.text: mamāntar leḍhi marmāṇi sītāvirahamurmuraḥ //
children.translated_text: the billow of <s>Sītā</s>'s separation licks at my vital parts within.

children.text: tvadvākyaśīkarair ebhir niruddhabahirudgamaḥ /
mama antar leḍhi marmāṇi sītāvirahamurmuraḥ //
tasmād api dahaty uccair ayaṃ mām aparaḥ śikhī /
children.translated_text: Yet even more than that, this other fire burns me fiercely —

children.text: yad vanaukasi nirvaire mukto vālini mārgaṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: that an arrow was released against the blameless forest-dweller <s>Vālin</s>.

children.text: tasmād api dahaty uccair ayaṃ mām aparaḥ śikhī /
yad vanaukasi nirvaire mukto vālini mārgaṇaḥ //
gurvī punaś ca lajjeyam uttamarṇair ivādhunā /
children.translated_text: And further, this weighty shame presses [upon me] now, as if by creditors —

children.text: mārgitavyo yad asmābhiḥ plavagāḥ pratyupakriyām //
children.translated_text: that we must seek from the monkeys their reciprocal aid.

children.text: gurvī punaś ca lajja īyam uttamarṇair iva adhunā /
mārgitavyo yad asmābhiḥ plavagāḥ pratyupakriyām //
nāsti pratyupakārāśā tatra naś capale kapau /
children.translated_text: There is no hope of reciprocation for us from that fickle monkey,

children.text: yenātilaghunottuṅgo laṅghitaḥ satyapādapaḥ //
children.translated_text: by whom the lofty tree of truth has been overleapt with utmost lightness.

children.text: na asti pratyupakārāśā tatra naś capale kapau /
yena atilaghuna ūttuṅgo laṅghitaḥ satyapādapaḥ //
uttiṣṭha vatsa gacchāvaḥ sādhayāmo 'nyato 'dhunā /
children.translated_text: Rise, my child, let us go; let us accomplish our goal elsewhere now.

children.text: navaiśvaryasukhavyagraḥ sugrīvo nāgam iṣyati //
children.translated_text: <s>Sugrīva</s>, engrossed in the pleasures of his new sovereignty, does not desire to come.

children.text: uttiṣṭha vatsa gacchāvaḥ sādhayāmo 'nyato 'dhunā /
navaiśvaryasukhavyagraḥ sugrīvo nāgam iṣyati //
tapasvī ramatām evaṃ cirād dāraiḥ samāgataḥ /
children.translated_text: Let the ascetic enjoy himself, reunited with his wife after a long time.

children.text: sa pīḍyamānaḥ praṇayād virasaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati //
children.translated_text: Pressed by love, what will he do for one who is bereft of joy?

children.text: tapasvī ramatām evaṃ cirād dāraiḥ samāgataḥ /
sa pīḍyamānaḥ praṇayād virasaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati //
kiṃ ca vatsa daśāsāmyāj jātāḥ smaḥ suhṛdaḥ purā /
children.translated_text: Moreover, my child, we became friends formerly due to similarity of circumstances.

children.text: tasyādhunā tu vistīrṇavibhavāndhasya ke vayam //
children.translated_text: But now, who are we to him, blinded as he is by his vast prosperity?

children.text: kiṃ ca vatsa daśāsāmyāj jātāḥ smaḥ suhṛdaḥ purā /
tasya adhunā tu vistīrṇavibhavāndhasya ke vayam //
gṛhītasādhuvartmāpi sadyaḥ samprāpya sampadam /
children.translated_text: Even one who has taken the right path, upon suddenly attaining wealth,

children.text: patati skhalito 'tīva pramattaḥ prahate pathi //
children.translated_text: falls, stumbling greatly, heedless, on the broad road.

children.text: gṛhītasādhuvartma āpi sadyaḥ samprāpya sampadam /
patati skhalito 'tīva pramattaḥ prahate pathi //
sa vatsa viralo jantur vipatkālapratiśrutam /
children.translated_text: Rare indeed, my child, is that creature whose

children.text: sadyaḥ sampanmado yasya na vilumpati cetasi //
children.translated_text: intoxication with sudden prosperity does not destroy in his mind the promises made in times of misfortune.

children.text: sa vatsa viralo jantur vipatkālapratiśrutam /
sadyaḥ sampanmado yasya na vilumpati cetasi //
astu sādhur asādhur vā na vicāryaḥ sa me 'dhunā /
children.translated_text: Whether he is good or bad, I should not now deliberate about him.

children.text: vatsa notsahate cetas tatra dogdhum upakriyām //
children.translated_text: My child, my heart cannot bring itself to extract a service from him.

children.text: astu sādhur asādhur vā na vicāryaḥ sa me 'dhunā /
vatsa na utsahate cetas tatra dogdhum upakriyām //
asāv anāgataḥ śreyān āgacchan vatsa vāryatām /
children.translated_text: If he has not come, it is better so; if he comes, my child, let him be stopped.

children.text: praveśayanti suhṛdaṃ na dhīrāḥ svārthasaṃkaṭe //
children.translated_text: The wise do not let a friend enter into the narrow confines of their own affairs.

children.text: asāv anāgataḥ śreyān āgacchan vatsa vāryatām /
praveśayanti suhṛdaṃ na dhīrāḥ svārthasaṃkaṭe //
kartavyopakṛtiḥ sadbhir yatra tatra vipadgate /
children.translated_text: Good men should render assistance to one in distress wherever he may be.

children.text: avimṛśya kṛto 'smābhiḥ sa punaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ paṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: But the bargain we struck was a wretched one, made by us without reflection.

children.text: kartavya ūpakṛtiḥ sadbhir yatra tatra vipadgate /
avimṛśya kṛto 'smābhiḥ sa punaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ paṇaḥ //
kiṃ kṣiptam acalaprāntād antaḥsuptaśivāśatam /
children.translated_text: What did I do? Like a man following orders, I merely threw

children.text: nirdeśapuruṣeṇeva kaṅkālaṃ dundubher mayā //
children.translated_text: the skeleton of <s>Dundubhi</s> from the mountain's edge, with a hundred jackals sleeping inside.

children.text: kiṃ kṣiptam acalaprāntād antaḥsuptaśivāśatam /
nirdeśapuruṣeṇa iva kaṅkālaṃ dundubher mayā //
kasyārthasya kṛte viddhāḥ sapta sālās tapasvinaḥ /
children.translated_text: For whose sake were the seven innocent <s>sāla</s> trees pierced?

children.text: sa mā pratyetu vaidheyaḥ kiṃ na sādhitam anyataḥ //
children.translated_text: Let that dutiful one come to me—what could not be accomplished elsewhere?

children.text: kasya arthasya kṛte viddhāḥ sapta sālās tapasvinaḥ /
sa mā pratyetu vaidheyaḥ kiṃ na sādhitam anyataḥ //
akṣātraṃ kṣatriyayuvā ko nu rāma iva kṣipet /
children.translated_text: What young <s>kṣatriya</s> other than <s>Rāma</s> would release

children.text: viśikhaṃ vālini vyagre sugrīvasya paśoḥ kṛte //
children.translated_text: an un-<s>kṣatriya</s>-like arrow at <s>Vālin</s> while he was engaged in combat, for the sake of the brute <s>Sugrīva</s>?

children.text: akṣātraṃ kṣatriyayuvā ko nu rāma iva kṣipet /
viśikhaṃ vālini vyagre sugrīvasya paśoḥ kṛte //
na parityajyate mārgas tāvan nirvācyakardamaḥ /
children.translated_text: A road whose mire is unspeakable is not abandoned

children.text: yāvat pihitakaṣṭāya kāryāyātmā na dīyate //
children.translated_text: until one has given oneself to an undertaking whose hardships are concealed.

children.text: na parityajyate mārgas tāvan nirvācyakardamaḥ /
yāvat pihitakaṣṭāya kāryāyā atmā na dīyate //
iṣvaikayā mayā viddho bāliśena valīmukhaḥ /
children.translated_text: I, the fool, struck <s>Vālin</s> with a single arrow;

children.text: anuddhārāḥ śarās tena ropitā mayi vāṅmayāḥ //
children.translated_text: but by him, verbal arrows that cannot be extracted were planted in me.

children.text: iṣva aikayā mayā viddho bāliśena valīmukhaḥ /
anuddhārāḥ śarās tena ropitā mayi vāṅmayāḥ //
anavāptavipatpāraḥ smariṣyāmi kiyanti vā /
children.translated_text: How many things shall I remember, not having crossed to the other shore of calamity?

children.text: vatsa kālocitaṃ śādhi na rāmaḥ kiṃcid īkṣate //
children.translated_text: My child, advise what is suited to the time; <s>Rāma</s> sees nothing clearly.

children.text: anavāptavipatpāraḥ smariṣyāmi kiyanti vā /
vatsa kālocitaṃ śādhi na rāmaḥ kiṃcid īkṣate //
avalambasva māṃ bhrātaḥ sītāsmaraṇanissaham /
children.translated_text: Support me, brother, for I cannot bear the memory of <s>Sītā</s>.

children.text: dūraṃ punaḥ prabhavatā mano mohena lupyate //
children.translated_text: Once again my mind is overwhelmed by a powerful delusion from afar.

children.text: avalambasva māṃ bhrātaḥ sītāsmaraṇanissaham /
dūraṃ punaḥ prabhavatā mano mohena lupyate //
sanāthobhayapārśvasya tvayā vatsa tayā ca me /
children.translated_text: Protected on both sides by you, my child, and by her,

children.text: vaneṣu ca sataḥ kaṣṭam ajaniṣṭa na kiṃcana //
children.translated_text: nothing painful arose for me even while dwelling in the forests.

children.text: sanāthobhayapārśvasya tvayā vatsa tayā ca me /
vaneṣu ca sataḥ kaṣṭam ajaniṣṭa na kiṃcana //
hā bhīru hā priyatame hā madvirahakātare /
children.translated_text: 'Alas, my timid one! Alas, my dearest! Alas, you who are tormented by separation from me!

children.text: kvāsīty ardhoktinissaṃjño jagāma sa mahītalam //
children.translated_text: Where are you?'—uttering half these words, he fell unconscious to the ground.

children.text: hā bhīru hā priyatame hā madvirahakātare /
kva asi ity ardhoktinissaṃjño jagāma sa mahītalam //
mātaḥ kaikeyi tuṣṭāsi bhuṅkṣva rājyam akaṇṭakam /
children.translated_text: 'Mother <s>Kaikeyī</s>, are you satisfied? Enjoy the kingdom without thorns!'—

children.text: vadann ity apatat tasya lakṣmaṇaś caraṇābjayoḥ //
children.translated_text: saying thus, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> fell at his lotus feet.

children.text: mātaḥ kaikeyi tuṣṭa āsi bhuṅkṣva rājyam akaṇṭakam /
vadann ity apatat tasya lakṣmaṇaś caraṇābjayoḥ //
tatas tau sāśrunayanau mṛgair vidhuravīkṣitau /
children.translated_text: Then those two, with tear-filled eyes, gazed at with distress by the deer,

children.text: nipetatur diva iva bhraṣṭau vidhuravī kṣitau //
children.translated_text: fell to the ground like the moon and the sun fallen from the sky to the earth.

children.text: tatas tau sāśrunayanau mṛgair vidhuravīkṣitau /
nipetatur diva iva bhraṣṭau vidhuravī kṣitau //
iti nipatitayos tayor dvayor daśarathanandanayor mahītale /
children.translated_text: When those two sons of <s>Daśaratha</s> had thus fallen to the ground,

children.text: daśabhir api digaṅganāmukhair adhṛtivaśād iva tatyaje ruciḥ //
children.translated_text: the radiance departed from even the ten faces of the direction-maidens, as if from loss of composure.

children.text: iti nipatitayos tayor dvayor daśarathanandanayor mahītale /
daśabhir api digaṅganāmukhair adhṛtivaśād iva tatyaje ruciḥ //
ete nikāmarasikasya jayanti pādāḥ śrīhāravarṣayuvarājamahītalendoḥ /
children.translated_text: Victorious are these verses of the supremely discerning one, the moon of the earth, Crown Prince <s>Śrī Hāravarṣa</s>,

children.text: yair dvādaśārkakiraṇotkaradurnivāraḥ sṛṣṭo 'bhinandakumudasya mahāvikāsaḥ //
children.translated_text: by whom the great blossoming of the night-lily that is <s>Abhinanda</s>—irresistible as the shower of rays from twelve suns—was produced.

children.text: ete nikāmarasikasya jayanti pādāḥ śrīhāravarṣayuvarājamahītalendoḥ /
yair dvādaśārkakiraṇotkaradurnivāraḥ sṛṣṭo 'bhinandakumudasya mahāvikāsaḥ //
ity abhinandakṛtau rāmacarite mahākāvye prathamaḥ sargaḥ samāptaḥ |/
children.translated_text: Thus ends the first canto in the <s>Rāmacarita Mahākāvya</s> composed by <s>Abhinanda</s>.

children.text: dvitīyaḥ sargaḥ
children.translated_text: Second Canto

children.text: tām anīkṣitacarīm adhīratām ātmano 'tha viniyamya lakṣmaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: Then <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, restraining that ignoble weakness of his own,

children.text: sāntvanārtham iti vācam abravīt tīvramanyurayamūḍham agrajam //
children.translated_text: spoke these words for consolation to his elder brother, stupefied with fierce anger:

children.text: tām anīkṣitacarīm adhīratām ātmano 'tha viniyamya lakṣmaṇaḥ /
sāntvanārtham iti vācam abravīt tīvramanyurayamūḍham agrajam //
kāryam ārya pariśiṣṭam ucyatāṃ mucyatām idam ayogajaṃ tamaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Let the remaining task be spoken of, O noble one. Let this darkness born of impropriety be released.

children.text: rājatūdyamadivākarodayasmeram āśu mukhapaṅkajaṃ tava //
children.translated_text: Let your lotus face quickly bloom with the smile of the sunrise of royal endeavor.

children.text: kāryam ārya pariśiṣṭam ucyatāṃ mucyatām idam ayogajaṃ tamaḥ /
rājatu udyamadivākarodayasmeram āśu mukhapaṅkajaṃ tava //
āsituṃ samaya eṣa nāvayor moham ittham avalambituṃ na ca /
children.translated_text: This is the time for us two to deliberate, not to indulge in delusion thus.

children.text: utsahasva nanu hṛṣyatāṃ cirādiṣv adhīnam adhunābhikāṅkṣitam //
children.translated_text: Exert yourself! Let there be joy! What has long been desired is now within reach of command.

children.text: āsituṃ samaya eṣa nā avayor moham ittham avalambituṃ na ca /
utsahasva nanu hṛṣyatāṃ cirādiṣv adhīnam adhuna ābhikāṅkṣitam //
kevalaṃ phalabhujo na tasya nas taskarasya nilaye 'sti niścayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Only, we have no certainty about the lair of that thief who enjoys the fruit.

children.text: abhyupaitu ravinandanaḥ kṣaṇād andhakāram idam apy apaiṣyati //
children.translated_text: Let the Son of the Sun (<s>Sugrīva</s>) come at once—this darkness too will depart.

children.text: kevalaṃ phalabhujo na tasya nas taskarasya nilaye 'sti niścayaḥ /
abhyupaitu ravinandanaḥ kṣaṇād andhakāram idam apy apaiṣyati //
aurasān api sutān arīn iva ghnanti kāraṇavaśān mahībhujaḥ /
children.translated_text: Kings kill even their own sons like enemies, compelled by circumstances.

children.text: nigrahād anujavidviṣaḥ kapeḥ kiṃ pṛthagjana ivānutapyase //
children.translated_text: Why do you, like a common person, repent the killing of the younger brother's enemy, the monkey?

children.text: aurasān api sutān arīn iva ghnanti kāraṇavaśān mahībhujaḥ /
nigrahād anujavidviṣaḥ kapeḥ kiṃ pṛthagjana iva anutapyase //
krīḍatāṃ mṛgavaneṣu dhanvināṃ jīvakoṭikadane 'pi kā kṣatiḥ /
children.translated_text: What harm is there in the killing of even tens of millions of lives for hunters sporting in the deer-forests?

children.text: khidyase kim aniśaṃ prayojanād ekavānaravadhaḥ kutaḥ kṛtaḥ //
children.translated_text: Why do you grieve incessantly? The killing of one monkey was done for a purpose.

children.text: krīḍatāṃ mṛgavaneṣu dhanvināṃ jīvakoṭikadane 'pi kā kṣatiḥ /
khidyase kim aniśaṃ prayojanād ekavānaravadhaḥ kutaḥ kṛtaḥ //
tasya ca pravayaso jaṭāyuṣaḥ svargiṇaḥ kim adhunānuśocyate /
children.translated_text: And why grieve now for that aged <s>Jaṭāyus</s>, who has gone to heaven,

children.text: yena jarjarakalevaravyayāt krītam indukiraṇojjvalaṃ yaśaḥ //
children.translated_text: who with the expenditure of his decrepit body purchased fame radiant as moonbeams?

children.text: tasya ca pravayaso jaṭāyuṣaḥ svargiṇaḥ kim adhuna ānuśocyate /
yena jarjarakalevaravyayāt krītam indukiraṇojjvalaṃ yaśaḥ //
etad ekam ativāhyatām ahaḥ śvo na sa plavagarāṭpratīkṣyate /
children.translated_text: Let just this one day pass; tomorrow that monkey-king shall not need to be waited for.

children.text: tat prasīda parito vicīyatātmanaiva sanagārṇavāvaniḥ //
children.translated_text: So be at peace; let the earth with its forests, mountains, and seas be searched by you yourself on all sides.

children.text: etad ekam ativāhyatām ahaḥ śvo na sa plavagarāṭpratīkṣyate /
tat prasīda parito vicīyatā ātmana aiva sanagārṇava āvaniḥ //
tat kabandhaśabarīhanūmatām āvayor ajani saṅgataṃ yathā /
children.translated_text: Just as our meeting with <s>Kabandha</s>, <s>Śabarī</s>, and <s>Hanumān</s> came about

children.text: iṣṭaśaṃsi vanaśailapānthayoḥ kiṃ tathānyad api nāpatet punaḥ //
children.translated_text: auspiciously for us two wanderers in forests and mountains, could not something similar happen again?

children.text: tat kabandhaśabarīhanūmatām āvayor ajani saṅgataṃ yathā /
iṣṭaśaṃsi vanaśailapānthayoḥ kiṃ tatha ānyad api nā apatet punaḥ //
yatra yatra tava siddhir agrataḥ kaḥ kariṣyati na te samīhitam /
children.translated_text: Wherever your accomplishment shines before you, who will not fulfill your desire?

children.text: ujjvale kṛtavidāṃ na kevalaṃ tena vartmani durātmanā sthitam //
children.translated_text: It is not only by that wicked one that the radiant path of the grateful has been trodden.

children.text: yatra yatra tava siddhir agrataḥ kaḥ kariṣyati na te samīhitam /
ujjvale kṛtavidāṃ na kevalaṃ tena vartmani durātmanā sthitam //
sambhavaty abhimaraḥ pure 'thavā tasya tīvram ayaśaḥ kim ucyate /
children.translated_text: Perhaps there could even be an assault on his city—what need be said of his intense infamy?

children.text: duḥkham utkhanati kaṇṭakāvalīr aṅgasandhiṣu navaḥ kileśvaraḥ //
children.translated_text: A new lord, they say, painfully uproots rows of thorns embedded in the joints of the limbs.

children.text: sambhavaty abhimaraḥ pure 'thavā tasya tīvram ayaśaḥ kim ucyate /
duḥkham utkhanati kaṇṭakāvalīr aṅgasandhiṣu navaḥ kilā iśvaraḥ //
samprati prathamam ārya gṛhyatāṃ tatpravṛttim upalabdhum udyamaḥ /
children.translated_text: Now first, O noble one, let an effort be undertaken

children.text: marṣaṇīyaparilambadūṣaṇaḥ so 'dhunāpy akapaṭo ghaṭate cet //
children.translated_text: to ascertain his activities. If he, whose fault of delay is excusable, sincerely exerts himself even now—

children.text: samprati prathamam ārya gṛhyatāṃ tatpravṛttim upalabdhum udyamaḥ /
marṣaṇīyaparilambadūṣaṇaḥ so 'dhuna āpy akapaṭo ghaṭate cet //
muñca moham avatīryatām itaḥ sevyatām iyam anāvilā nadī /
children.translated_text: Release this delusion; come down from here; let this clear river be attended to.

children.text: eṣa gacchati javāj japāruṇo vāruṇīm aruṇasārathir diśam //
children.translated_text: See, the sun, red as the <s>japā</s> flower, with <s>Aruṇa</s> as his charioteer, moves toward the western direction.

children.text: muñca moham avatīryatām itaḥ sevyatām iyam anāvilā nadī /
eṣa gacchati javāj japāruṇo vāruṇīm aruṇasārathir diśam //
unmimīla raghunandanaś cirāt tan niśamya vacanaṃ camatkṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: After a long time, <s>Raghunandana</s> (Rāma) opened his eyes, astonished upon hearing that speech.

children.text: apy ayogavidhurā na śerate saṃmukhīnavidhayas tathāvidhāḥ //
children.translated_text: Even those bereft of yogic discipline do not remain prostrate when such counsels present themselves directly.

children.text: unmimīla raghunandanaś cirāt tan niśamya vacanaṃ camatkṛtaḥ /
apy ayogavidhurā na śerate saṃmukhīnavidhayas tathāvidhāḥ //
muktamoham avalokya lakṣmaṇas taṃ mṛgāṅkam iva meghanirgatam /
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, seeing him freed from delusion like the moon emerging from a cloud,

children.text: ādade 'tha śaśikāntabhūdharasyandabinduśiśirāṃ sarasvatīm //
children.translated_text: then took up his speech, cool as the trickling drops from a moonstone mountain.

children.text: muktamoham avalokya lakṣmaṇas taṃ mṛgāṅkam iva meghanirgatam /
ādade 'tha śaśikāntabhūdharasyandabinduśiśirāṃ sarasvatīm //
eṣa paśya patito nabhastalād astaśailagahaneṣu naśyati /
children.translated_text: 'See, fallen from the sky, vanishing into the depths of the setting mountain,

children.text: sandhyayā caramadikpragalbhayā bhagnasāndrakarapañjaraḥ khagaḥ //
children.translated_text: that bird [the sun], its cage of dense rays shattered by the bold twilight of the western direction.

children.text: eṣa paśya patito nabhastalād astaśailagahaneṣu naśyati /
sandhyayā caramadikpragalbhayā bhagnasāndrakarapañjaraḥ khagaḥ //
śakyam arcitum anuccapāṇibhiḥ pāśapāṇinagarīnivāsibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: The sun, red as <s>bandhujīva</s> flowers, gently curved in the distance,

children.text: sānurodha iva dūrabandhuro bandhujīvakusumāruṇo raviḥ //
children.translated_text: can now be worshipped even by the residents of the city of the Noose-bearer (<s>Yama</s>), with hands not raised high, as if solicitous.

children.text: śakyam arcitum anuccapāṇibhiḥ pāśapāṇinagarīnivāsibhiḥ /
sānurodha iva dūrabandhuro bandhujīvakusumāruṇo raviḥ //
eṣa muktakarapāṭavo ravir nāṭayaty anuguṇatvam appatau /
children.translated_text: See, the sun, having released his skill of wielding rays, enacts conformity with his setting.

children.text: āpadi prakṛtir ujjhitā varaṃ nāśrayasya visadṛg viceṣṭitam //
children.translated_text: In adversity, abandoning one's own nature is better—one should not act differently from one's protector.

children.text: eṣa muktakarapāṭavo ravir nāṭayaty anuguṇatvam appatau /
āpadi prakṛtir ujjhitā varaṃ nā aśrayasya visadṛg viceṣṭitam //
bimbamūlarucirā raver amī recayanti gaganaṃ gabhastayaḥ /
children.translated_text: These rays of the sun, beautiful at the base of his orb, vacate the sky

children.text: pūrayanti ca mahīṃ mahīruhām āyatāḥ pratiśarīrayaṣṭayaḥ //
children.translated_text: and fill the earth with the elongated shadow-staffs of trees.

children.text: bimbamūlarucirā raver amī recayanti gaganaṃ gabhastayaḥ /
pūrayanti ca mahīṃ mahīruhām āyatāḥ pratiśarīrayaṣṭayaḥ //
agrataḥ śikharaśākhisaṃhateś chāyayopacitayāpasāritaḥ /
children.translated_text: Pushed forward by the augmented shadow of the massed peak-trees,

children.text: pṛṣṭhato 'tinibhṛtaṃ mahībhṛtām ātapaḥ kaṭakam āśu nojjhati //
children.translated_text: the sunlight at the mountains' back, deeply hidden, does not quickly abandon its regiment.

children.text: agrataḥ śikharaśākhisaṃhateś chāyaya ūpacitaya āpasāritaḥ /
pṛṣṭhato 'tinibhṛtaṃ mahībhṛtām ātapaḥ kaṭakam āśu na ujjhati //
svīkaroti śanakair anokahacchāyam adriśikharasthalīr api /
children.translated_text: The shadow of the trees gradually takes possession of even the mountain-peak plateaus.

children.text: hīyate nijavapuṣy api kramād ātapasya mamatā tapasvinaḥ //
children.translated_text: The poor sun's attachment to his own body also diminishes progressively.

children.text: svīkaroti śanakair anokahacchāyam adriśikharasthalīr api /
hīyate nijavapuṣy api kramād ātapasya mamatā tapasvinaḥ //
appater diśi viceṣṭate ravir vyākulāḥ śakunayaḥ svananty amī /
children.translated_text: The sun struggles in the direction of setting; these birds cry out in confusion.

children.text: dhvāntadṛṣṭiviṣadarśanād dine durnivāranidhane nimīlati //
children.translated_text: The day closes its eyes, seeing the poison-aspect of darkness, hard to ward off, at its inevitable end.

children.text: appater diśi viceṣṭate ravir vyākulāḥ śakunayaḥ svananty amī /
dhvāntadṛṣṭiviṣadarśanād dine durnivāranidhane nimīlati //
kīryate kṛtaravaiḥ khagavrajair eṣa tallataṭacaityapādapaḥ /
children.translated_text: This shrine-tree on the riverbank is crowded by flocks of birds making noise,

children.text: sāyam adhvanikaṭe nirargalaḥ sajjanālaya iva pravāsibhiḥ //
children.translated_text: like an unbarred abode of good people at evening, crowded by travelers.

children.text: kīryate kṛtaravaiḥ khagavrajair eṣa tallataṭacaityapādapaḥ /
sāyam adhvanikaṭe nirargalaḥ sajjanālaya iva pravāsibhiḥ //
yānti khinnajanasevyatām amī saumya sormiśucivālukācayāḥ /
children.translated_text: These riverbanks, O gentle one, with their heaps of waves, sand, white and pure,

children.text: prāntasuptakalahaṃsapaṅktayaḥ svairanīramaruto nadītaṭāḥ //
children.translated_text: with rows of swans sleeping at the edges and breezes blowing freely over the waters, attain the charm of being sought by weary folk.

children.text: yānti khinnajanasevyatām amī saumya sormiśucivālukācayāḥ /
prāntasuptakalahaṃsapaṅktayaḥ svairanīramaruto nadītaṭāḥ //
dhik taṭāntavasatīn sitacchadān paśyataḥ kamalaṣaṇḍavaiśasam /
children.translated_text: Shame on the white-winged ones dwelling on the banks, who watch the massacre of the lotus-groves!

children.text: staumi taṃ divasam ārya kevalaṃ yo 'stam eti samam abjabandhunā //
children.translated_text: I praise only that day, O noble one, which sets together with the friend of lotuses.

children.text: dhik taṭāntavasatīn sitacchadān paśyataḥ kamalaṣaṇḍavaiśasam /
staumi taṃ divasam ārya kevalaṃ yo 'stam eti samam abjabandhunā //
dantamūlanihitaikasallakīpallavo 'lasavilokitānugaḥ /
children.translated_text: See, this lord of elephants, with a branch of the <s>sallakī</s> tree placed at the root of his tusks, his gaze lazily following his mates,

children.text: eṣa muktagirikandaraḥ śanair vāri vāraṇapatiḥ pratiṣṭhate //
children.translated_text: having left the mountain cave, slowly moves toward the water.

children.text: dantamūlanihitaikasallakīpallavo 'lasavilokitānugaḥ /
eṣa muktagirikandaraḥ śanair vāri vāraṇapatiḥ pratiṣṭhate //
śīlayanti kariṇaḥ svavāsitāvāri sairibhasamūharecitam /
children.translated_text: The elephants stir the water of their females—water already churned by the herd of buffalo.

children.text: mālatīvanavikāsavāsitā vānti palvalataṭāntavāyavaḥ //
children.translated_text: Breezes blow from the edges of the pools, fragrant with the blooming of <s>mālatī</s> flower-groves.

children.text: śīlayanti kariṇaḥ svavāsitāvāri sairibhasamūharecitam /
mālatīvanavikāsavāsitā vānti palvalataṭāntavāyavaḥ //
saṃtyajanti masṛṇaṃ saraḥsarittallamūlasalilāni sairibhāḥ /
children.translated_text: The buffalo abandon the smooth waters at the roots of the reeds of the lake and river-banks.

children.text: sambhajanti sahasā bhayadrutair īkṣitāḥ kurarasārasairibhāḥ //
children.translated_text: Suddenly they take to the shore, gazed at by ospreys and cranes fleeing in alarm.

children.text: saṃtyajanti masṛṇaṃ saraḥsarittallamūlasalilāni sairibhāḥ /
sambhajanti sahasā bhayadrutair īkṣitāḥ kurarasārasairibhāḥ //
saṃmukhīnaghanapatrabandhanāt paśya paṅkajavanād anāratam /
children.translated_text: See, from the lotus-grove with its dense leaf-canopy now turned toward them, continuously,

children.text: pītakośamakarandasaṃcayāḥ saṃcaranti madhupāḥ kumudvatīm //
children.translated_text: the bees, having drunk the accumulated nectar of the yellow-stamened lotuses, move to the night-lily pond.

children.text: saṃmukhīnaghanapatrabandhanāt paśya paṅkajavanād anāratam /
pītakośamakarandasaṃcayāḥ saṃcaranti madhupāḥ kumudvatīm //
nopanītamukhamudram ambujaṃ muktamudram atha naiva kairavam /
children.translated_text: The lotus has not yet presented its face-seal; the night-lily has not yet released its seal.

children.text: etadīkṣitaparasparaṃ punaḥ patriyugmam apanidravaiśasam //
children.translated_text: And this pair of birds, gazing at each other, suffers the cruelty of approaching sleepy separation.

children.text: na upanītamukhamudram ambujaṃ muktamudram atha na eva kairavam /
etadīkṣitaparasparaṃ punaḥ patriyugmam apanidravaiśasam //
rodhasaḥ pulinam abjinīṃ tatas tām atītya bhajate kumudvatīm /
children.translated_text: A bird, leaving the bank, the sandbar, and the lotus-pond, then goes to the night-lily pond.

children.text: tatra tapta iva gāhate payaḥ sāyam ārdraviraho vihaṅgamaḥ //
children.translated_text: There, as if scorched, it enters the water at evening, its grief of separation fresh.

children.text: rodhasaḥ pulinam abjinīṃ tatas tām atītya bhajate kumudvatīm /
tatra tapta iva gāhate payaḥ sāyam ārdraviraho vihaṅgamaḥ //
svīkṛtaṃ na nalinair nimīlitaṃ na sphuṭaṃ kumudakuḍmalasmitam /
children.translated_text: Not accepted by the lotuses, which are closing; nor by the night-lily buds, which have not yet opened with smiles—

children.text: etadīkṣitaparasparaṃ paraṃ mūḍham ambhasi vihaṅgamadvayam //
children.translated_text: gazing at each other, this pair of birds is utterly bewildered in the water.

children.text: svīkṛtaṃ na nalinair nimīlitaṃ na sphuṭaṃ kumudakuḍmalasmitam /
etadīkṣitaparasparaṃ paraṃ mūḍham ambhasi vihaṅgamadvayam //
jarjaraṃ tyajati vāsaraplavaṃ na prasārayati mantharān karān /
children.translated_text: The sun abandons the decrepit raft of day, does not extend his sluggish rays;

children.text: ety adṛṣṭam avalambya kevalaṃ vyomavārinidhiśeṣam aṃśumān //
children.translated_text: relying only on the unseen, he proceeds, with only a remnant of the sky-ocean remaining.

children.text: jarjaraṃ tyajati vāsaraplavaṃ na prasārayati mantharān karān /
ety adṛṣṭam avalambya kevalaṃ vyomavārinidhiśeṣam aṃśumān //
śrāvitāgamam iva dvijāravair dhvāntam oṃ iti jagat pratīcchati /
children.translated_text: The world accepts the darkness with an '<s>Oṃ</s>,' as if taught the sacred scripture by the cries of birds.

children.text: trātum ūṣmarahitaḥ kṣamo 'dhunā na svamaṇḍalam api prabhākaraḥ //
children.translated_text: The sun, devoid of warmth, is no longer capable of protecting even his own disc.

children.text: śrāvitāgamam iva dvijāravair dhvāntam oṃ iti jagat pratīcchati /
trātum ūṣmarahitaḥ kṣamo 'dhunā na svamaṇḍalam api prabhākaraḥ //
dṛśyatām udayati sma yādṛśas tādṛśas taraṇir astam īyate /
children.translated_text: See, the sun sets just as he rose.

children.text: utsavavyasanayoḥ prabhur vidhir vikriyāsu mahatām anīśvaraḥ //
children.translated_text: Fate is the lord of both festivity and calamity, but is powerless over the transformations of the great.

children.text: dṛśyatām udayati sma yādṛśas tādṛśas taraṇir astam īyate /
utsavavyasanayoḥ prabhur vidhir vikriyāsu mahatām anīśvaraḥ //
sphītam abjakulam īkṣyatām itas tallam ullasitahaṃsasārasam /
children.translated_text: See from here the abundant lotus-colony on this side, the banks joyful with swans and cranes,

children.text: niścalācchaparimaṇḍalodakaprāntamantharamṛṇālakaṇṭakam //
children.translated_text: with clear, perfectly rounded water, and sluggish lotus-root stalks at the edges.

children.text: sphītam abjakulam īkṣyatām itas tallam ullasitahaṃsasārasam /
niścalācchaparimaṇḍalodakaprāntamantharamṛṇālakaṇṭakam //
śīlayanty acalamekhalāsv amī śītalāsu ruravo nirudyamāḥ /
children.translated_text: These deer, without effort, in the cool mountain-girdle slopes,

children.text: pūrvaśaṣpakabalānuvartinaḥ stokacañcalamukhāḥ sukhāsikām //
children.translated_text: recline comfortably, following their earlier grass-morsels, with slightly moving mouths.

children.text: śīlayanty acalamekhalāsv amī śītalāsu ruravo nirudyamāḥ /
pūrvaśaṣpakabalānuvartinaḥ stokacañcalamukhāḥ sukhāsikām //
dīdhitīḥ paricitāḥ parityajaty abjinīr api ca nānurudhyate /
children.translated_text: The sun abandons his familiar rays and does not even attend to the lotus-ponds.

children.text: sandhyayā varuṇadigvadhūm anuprāpitaḥ kam api rāgam aṃśumān //
children.translated_text: The sun, having reached some redness through the twilight, has been escorted to the bride of the western quarter.

children.text: dīdhitīḥ paricitāḥ parityajaty abjinīr api ca na anurudhyate /
sandhyayā varuṇadigvadhūm anuprāpitaḥ kam api rāgam aṃśumān //
dyaū ravīndurahitāpi nirmalā bhūr avṛkṣasalilāpi śītalā /
children.translated_text: The sky is clear even without sun and moon; the earth is cool even without trees and water.

children.text: antarālam avalambya śobhate vāsarakṣaṇadayoḥ kṣaṇaṃ jagat //
children.translated_text: For a moment, poised between day and night, the world is beautiful.

children.text: dyaū ravīndurahita āpi nirmalā bhūr avṛkṣasalila āpi śītalā /
antarālam avalambya śobhate vāsarakṣaṇadayoḥ kṣaṇaṃ jagat //
nirjharo 'yam iyam āpagā saraḥ palvalaṃ ca vimalaṃ vibhāty adaḥ /
children.translated_text: This is a waterfall, this a river, that a lake, and that a clear pool.

children.text: yatra cittam iha paryupāsyatāṃ tatra tatrabhavatī pitṛprasūḥ //
children.translated_text: Wherever your heart inclines, let us sit here, where the revered river, daughter of the ancestors, flows.'

children.text: nirjharo 'yam iyam āpagā saraḥ palvalaṃ ca vimalaṃ vibhāty adaḥ /
yatra cittam iha paryupāsyatāṃ tatra tatrabhavatī pitṛprasūḥ //
ity ubhau vyavahitāntaravyathau tau samāpya samayocitaṃ vidhim /
children.translated_text: Then those two, <s>Rāma</s> and <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, their inner anguish concealed, having completed the rites appropriate to the time,

children.text: satkṛtiṃ dadhatur ānane mithaḥ prārthanāṃ kim api rāmalakṣmaṇau //
children.translated_text: placed upon each other's faces a certain entreaty and show of mutual respect.

children.text: ity ubhau vyavahitāntaravyathau tau samāpya samayocitaṃ vidhim /
satkṛtiṃ dadhatur ānane mithaḥ prārthanāṃ kim api rāmalakṣmaṇau //
yatra vāti na kumudvatīmarut kaumudī bata na yatra vīkṣyate /
children.translated_text: Where the breeze from the night-lily pond does not blow, where, alas, moonlight is not seen—

children.text: taṃ nirūpitasamantam añjasā bhejatuḥ parisaraṃ raghūdvahau //
children.translated_text: they quickly sought out that thoroughly examined area, those two scions of <s>Raghu</s>.

children.text: yatra vāti na kumudvatīmarut kaumudī bata na yatra vīkṣyate /
taṃ nirūpitasamantam añjasā bhejatuḥ parisaraṃ raghūdvahau //
dṛṣṭipāṇitalappātaśodhitām uddhṛtasthagitakaṇṭakāvaṭām /
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> cleared the ground by the sweep of his gaze and palm, removed the hidden thorns and pits,

children.text: astṛṇān navatṛṇena medināṃ rāmabhadraśayanāya lakṣmaṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: and spread fresh grass on the earth for the bed of <s>Rāmabhadra</s>.

children.text: dṛṣṭipāṇitalappātaśodhitām uddhṛtasthagitakaṇṭakāvaṭām /
astṛṇān navatṛṇena medināṃ rāmabhadraśayanāya lakṣmaṇaḥ //
nirṇineja sahasā suṣupsataḥ pādapadmayugam agrajanmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: He quickly washed the lotus-feet of his elder brother who wished to sleep,

children.text: svāṃśukoddhṛtajalaṃ karābjayoḥ kauśalāc ca samavāhayat punaḥ //
children.translated_text: and with water wrung from his own garment, he skilfully massaged his hands.

children.text: nirṇineja sahasā suṣupsataḥ pādapadmayugam agrajanmanaḥ /
svāṃśukoddhṛtajalaṃ karābjayoḥ kauśalāc ca samavāhayat punaḥ //
adhvajarjaritarājalakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmaṇaś caraṇam agrajanmanaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> touched for a long time the foot of his elder brother,

children.text: āmamarśa ciram aśru vartayan kevalopakaraṇena pāṇinā //
children.translated_text: its royal marks worn away by the road, shedding tears, with only his bare hand as an instrument.

children.text: adhvajarjaritarājalakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmaṇaś caraṇam agrajanmanaḥ /
āmamarśa ciram aśru vartayan kevalopakaraṇena pāṇinā //
svairam agrakarajair vivṛtya ca vyākulāṃ samanayaj jaṭāṭavīm /
children.translated_text: And with the tips of his fingers he gently parted and arranged the tangled mass of matted hair;

children.text: aṅgadeśam anayad vidhūya ca srastarātisṛtam añcalaṃ tvacaḥ //
children.translated_text: and having shaken off debris, he brought the trailing, slipping hem of the bark-garment to its proper place on the body.

children.text: svairam agrakarajair vivṛtya ca vyākulāṃ samanayaj jaṭāṭavīm /
aṅgadeśam anayad vidhūya ca srastarātisṛtam añcalaṃ tvacaḥ //
pārśvayor upadadhe maheṣudhī ādade śirasi pūjitaṃ dhanuḥ /
children.translated_text: He placed the great quivers at both sides; he placed the honored bow at the head;

children.text: unmamārja dhutasaṃhṛtena ca svāñcalena punaruktam āstaram //
children.translated_text: and with the edge of his garment, shaken and gathered, he wiped the grass-mat once again.

children.text: pārśvayor upadadhe maheṣudhī ādade śirasi pūjitaṃ dhanuḥ /
unmamārja dhutasaṃhṛtena ca svāñcalena punaruktam āstaram //
ity ajasram anujātasevayā jīyamānavanavāsayātanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus, with the ceaseless service of his younger brother allaying the torment of forest-dwelling,

children.text: svaptukāma iva sālasendriyaḥ saṃviveśa raghunandanaḥ kṣaṇam //
children.translated_text: <s>Raghunandana</s> (Rāma), wishing to sleep, his senses still as a <s>sāla</s> tree, lay down for a moment.

children.text: ity ajasram anujātasevayā jīyamānavanavāsayātanaḥ /
svaptukāma iva sālasendriyaḥ saṃviveśa raghunandanaḥ kṣaṇam //
mīlitonmiṣitalocanaḥ śanair jāgarūkam avalokya so 'nujam /
children.translated_text: With eyes flickering between closing and opening, slowly observing his younger brother who was keeping awake,

children.text: uccavāmakarapaṅkajodaranyastamaulir avadan mitaṃ vacaḥ //
children.translated_text: He [<s>Rāma</s>], resting his head upon the belly of his left and right lotus-hands, spoke measured words:

children.text: mīlitonmiṣitalocanaḥ śanair jāgarūkam avalokya so 'nujam /
uccavāmakarapaṅkajodaranyastamaulir avadan mitaṃ vacaḥ //
gaccha vatsa śayanīyam ātmanaḥ kliśyase kṛśataraḥ kiyac ciram /
children.translated_text: "Go, dear child, to your own bed — how long will you suffer, growing ever more emaciated?

children.text: nidrayā viśadatāṃ vraja kṣaṇaṃ na kṣamaḥ pratiniśīthajāgaraḥ //
children.translated_text: Enter the clarity of sleep for a moment; staying awake past midnight is not bearable for you.

children.text: gaccha vatsa śayanīyam ātmanaḥ kliśyase kṛśataraḥ kiyac ciram /
nidrayā viśadatāṃ vraja kṣaṇaṃ na kṣamaḥ pratiniśīthajāgaraḥ //
prātar asti bahu kṛtyam āvayor bhrātar ātmani kim asy atatparaḥ /
children.translated_text: "In the morning we two have much to do, O brother — why are you not mindful of yourself?

children.text: cintyatām uṣasi tasya saṃgatiḥ śītalasya kapicakravartinaḥ //
children.translated_text: Let the meeting with that cool one, the emperor of monkeys, be deliberated at dawn.

children.text: prātar asti bahu kṛtyam āvayor bhrātar ātmani kim asy atatparaḥ /
cintyatām uṣasi tasya saṃgatiḥ śītalasya kapicakravartinaḥ //
āspadādhigamagarvito 'stu vāpy astu vānuditabhūtivikriyaḥ /
children.translated_text: "Whether he is puffed up with pride at having gained his station, or whether his fortune has risen without [outward] transformation —

children.text: āvayoḥ samayabaddhayoḥ puno niścayārtham adhigamya eva saḥ //
children.translated_text: We, bound by our pact, shall determine the truth only after meeting him.

children.text: āspadādhigamagarvito 'stu va āpy astu va ānuditabhūtivikriyaḥ /
āvayoḥ samayabaddhayoḥ puno niścayārtham adhigamya eva saḥ //
tad vibhātu rajanī sukhena te yāsyataḥ plavagarājamandiram /
children.translated_text: "So let the night pass pleasantly for you, who will go to the palace of the monkey-king;

children.text: pakṣayor yad anurūpamuktayos tat tadaiva ca samarthayiṣyate //
children.translated_text: Whatever is fitting for both of us to say shall be considered then and there."

children.text: tad vibhātu rajanī sukhena te yāsyataḥ plavagarājamandiram /
pakṣayor yad anurūpamuktayos tat tada aiva ca samarthayiṣyate //
ūcivān iti babhūva nirvacāḥ kuḍmalīkṛtavilocanotpalaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having spoken thus, he fell silent, his lotus-eyes closed into buds;

children.text: adhyaśeta caraṇāmbujāntikaṃ tasya joṣam anagho jaghanyajaḥ //
children.translated_text: The sinless younger brother lay quietly near his lotus-feet.

children.text: ūcivān iti babhūva nirvacāḥ kuḍmalīkṛtavilocanotpalaḥ /
adhyaśeta caraṇāmbujāntikaṃ tasya joṣam anagho jaghanyajaḥ //
tatra tatra ca śayānayoś cirād vīrayor vigatasādhvasā iva /
children.translated_text: And as the two heroes lay sleeping here and there, for a long time, as if their fears had departed,

children.text: uddhatair dadur ulūkahuṃkṛtair andhakārajayaghoṣaṇāṃ drumāḥ //
children.translated_text: The trees, with the bold hooting of owls, issued proclamations of victory over the darkness.

children.text: tatra tatra ca śayānayoś cirād vīrayor vigatasādhvasā iva /
uddhatair dadur ulūkahuṃkṛtair andhakārajayaghoṣaṇāṃ drumāḥ //
vyātatoḍudaśanāpi mucyase na tvam arkacirasaṃstutādhunā /
children.translated_text: "Though your mouth gapes wide with star-teeth, O darkness, you shall not now be freed — you who have long been hymned by the sun" —

children.text: ity ariṣṭaripukūjitais tamo dyāṃ bruvāṇam iva dūram udyayau //
children.translated_text: Thus, as if the sky were speaking to the darkness through the cries of the enemy-bird [the owl], the darkness withdrew far away.

children.text: vyātatoḍudaśana āpi mucyase na tvam arkacirasaṃstuta ādhunā /
ity ariṣṭaripukūjitais tamo dyāṃ bruvāṇam iva dūram udyayau //
kevalaṃ śakunayo na nīḍagāḥ śākhino 'pi śayitāḥ samantataḥ /
children.translated_text: Not only the birds in their nests, but even the trees lying asleep on all sides

children.text: jajñire timirataskarāvalīlupyamānavibhavāś ca bhūbhṛtaḥ //
children.translated_text: Appeared as if their riches were being plundered by the thieving hordes of darkness — so too the mountains.

children.text: kevalaṃ śakunayo na nīḍagāḥ śākhino 'pi śayitāḥ samantataḥ /
jajñire timirataskarāvalīlupyamānavibhavāś ca bhūbhṛtaḥ //
na sthalī na pulinaṃ na sindhavo nācalā na taravaś cakāśire /
children.translated_text: Neither the plains, nor the sandbars, nor the rivers, nor the mountains, nor the trees could be seen;

children.text: dūṣitadvitayavādam udbabhāv ekam eva timiraṃ vibhūtimat //
children.translated_text: Refuting the doctrine of duality, darkness alone arose, mighty and supreme.

children.text: na sthalī na pulinaṃ na sindhavo na acalā na taravaś cakāśire /
dūṣitadvitayavādam udbabhāv ekam eva timiraṃ vibhūtimat //
tatra mugdhapṛṣatas tamoghane pārśvagām api mṛgīm ahārayat /
children.translated_text: In that dense darkness, a bewildered young deer could not distinguish even the doe at its side;

children.text: prāpa kokayuvatir yadṛcchayā patyur ādhitaralasya saṃgamam //
children.translated_text: A <s>cakravāka</s>-hen by chance attained union with her mate, who had been anxious [in separation].

children.text: tatra mugdhapṛṣatas tamoghane pārśvagām api mṛgīm ahārayat /
prāpa kokayuvatir yadṛcchayā patyur ādhitaralasya saṃgamam //
vṛddham aṅkam anayac chiśubhramāc cumbati sma dayiteti yūthapam /
children.translated_text: A she-elephant brought an old one to her side instead of a calf, and kissed the herd-bull thinking it was her beloved;

children.text: svīyam apy uditasaṃśayaḥ śanair aṅgam aṅgam amṛśad valīmukhaḥ //
children.translated_text: An old monkey, his doubts aroused, slowly felt limb by limb even his own body.

children.text: vṛddham aṅkam anayac chiśubhramāc cumbati sma dayita īti yūthapam /
svīyam apy uditasaṃśayaḥ śanair aṅgam aṅgam amṛśad valīmukhaḥ //
sarvataḥ parigateva parvatair āciteva tarubhir nirantaram /
children.translated_text: As if surrounded on all sides by mountains, as if densely studded with trees unbroken,

children.text: āpluteva salilair itas tataḥ śakyate sma cirasaṃstutāpi bhūḥ //
children.translated_text: As if flooded by waters from every direction — even the long-familiar earth could [not be recognized].

children.text: sarvataḥ parigata īva parvatair ācita īva tarubhir nirantaram /
āpluta īva salilair itas tataḥ śakyate sma cirasaṃstuta āpi bhūḥ //
dikṣu dakṣam avanāv anākulaṃ khe 'tikhelam aṭavīṣu bhīṣaṇam /
children.translated_text: In the directions, bold; on the ground, unperturbed; in the sky, exceedingly playful; in the forests, terrifying;

children.text: mattam adriṣu darīṣu durjayaṃ prādurāsa viṣame samaṃ tamaḥ //
children.translated_text: Intoxicated on the mountains, invincible in the caves — darkness appeared equally everywhere, impartial in the rough terrain.

children.text: dikṣu dakṣam avanāv anākulaṃ khe 'tikhelam aṭavīṣu bhīṣaṇam /
mattam adriṣu darīṣu durjayaṃ prādurāsa viṣame samaṃ tamaḥ //
bhejur aikyam iva tulyavaiśasāḥ sāyam eva malinair mukhair diśaḥ /
children.translated_text: The directions, their faces equally darkened, seemed to have merged into unity, sharing the same distress, at evening itself;

children.text: gṛhyamāṇaśikharā tamaścayair dyauḥ papāta vasudhāsakhītale //
children.translated_text: The sky, its peaks seized by masses of darkness, fell upon the surface of the earth, its companion.

children.text: bhejur aikyam iva tulyavaiśasāḥ sāyam eva malinair mukhair diśaḥ /
gṛhyamāṇaśikharā tamaścayair dyauḥ papāta vasudhāsakhītale //
pratyabhān na purato na pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvayoś ca viśadaṃ na kiṃcana /
children.translated_text: Nothing could be clearly perceived — neither in front, nor behind, nor on either side;

children.text: vyānaśe bhuvanam añjanācalaprasthapaṅktinibiḍaṃ niśātamaḥ //
children.translated_text: The world vanished, the night-darkness dense as the compact ridge-rows of Mount <s>Añjana</s> (the collyrium-mountain).

children.text: pratyabhān na purato na pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvayoś ca viśadaṃ na kiṃcana /
